items.reasoning: Read DiversityLogic.h 31-40 and 18-28 and dispatcher 89-94. The length at +0x1C is used only as a >0 gate. The pointer goes to IsExcludedFromDiversification, which scans with StartsWithCaseInsensitive until the prefix matches and never uses tagLen as a bound. So the read depends on the tag being NUL-terminated. Engine CExoString usually is, so the risk is fragile rather than shown. LevelUpOverride.cpp:937-940 copies exactly len bytes and NUL-terminates itself, showing the safer pattern.

output.notes: Items 3 and 4 concern the same ebp frame offsets; I split them as needs-human (3, residual binary risk) and refuted (4, premise that offsets are unsourced is false). Item 9 is refuted because an empty tag cannot match an exclusion prefix, so the length gate cannot cause a named NPC to be skipped. Items 1, 6 and 7 describe one underlying defect (frame-address seed), so their severities are kept at medium. Item 8 is confirmed low as a fragile NUL-scan assumption rather than a shown over-read.
